summary: Cartesia x Google Cloud Startups is 12 months of Cartesia Startup Tier for Scale Tier members of the Google for Startups Cloud Program: 1.25M credits per month, up to 5 concurrent requests, including Pro Voice Cloning. Distinct from the Cartesia Startups Grant (96M credits/year on cartesia.ai/startups). Cartesia pricing lists Startup at $49/mo with 1.25M credits/month and Pro voice cloning. The google-startups apply path 404s; claim via the program page as a GFS Cloud Program Scale Tier member.
claim_steps: Be a Scale Tier member of the Google for Startups Cloud Program.
Open https://www.cartesia.ai/google-startups and follow Cartesia's claim flow for that benefit (this is not the Cartesia Startups Grant at /startups).

social_proof.text: Startup: $49, 1.25M credits / month. Everything in Pro, plus Pro voice cloning and Organizations.
